name: OV7670-ESP32-NonFIFO
description: Hardware-DMA camera driver for a bare OV7670 (no AL422B FIFO) wired directly to an ESP32. Captures the 8-bit parallel DVP stream with the I2S0 camera peripheral instead of bit-banging GPIOs.
keywords: ov7670, camera, esp32, i2s, dma, dvp, sccb, non-fifo, image, sensor
